items.title: The fibre product of two complete Noetherian local rings over a common quotient is complete Noetherian local
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the fibre product of two surjections of complete Noetherian local rings over a common quotient is again a complete Noetherian local ring. The proof builds an explicit presentation: it chooses a Cohen ring or the residue field itself according to the characteristic, uses the Cohen structure theorem to write the quotient as a quotient of a power series ring, lifts the two surjections to that power series ring using formal smoothness of power series rings over a Cohen ring and the lifting of continuous maps, and then presents the fibre product as a quotient of a power series ring in the variables of the base together with generators of the two kernels. Being a quotient of a complete local ring makes the fibre product complete.
